english:
Dealing or receiving damage at least every 7 seconds builds 'Power of the Son', granting a stack after 12 seconds and reaching 2 stacks after 24 seconds.

Power of the Son grants 15%|25% Damage Resistance against PVE Combatants and ?%|?% Flinch Resistance at 1|2 stacks.

Maximum of 2 stacks.

source.text:
4 Piece | Power of the Son

While maintaining a state of dealing or receiving damage every 7 seconds:
Grants a stack of Power of the Son after 12 seconds, up to 2 stacks after 24 seconds.

Power of the Son x1 | 15% Damage Resist against Combatants and ?% Flinch Resist.
Power of the Son x2 | 25% Damage Resist against Combatants and ?% Flinch Resist.
